newsitem.title: FRANCE: G des Eaux sees big rise in oper profit.
newsitem.headline: G des Eaux sees big rise in oper profit.

text.p: Generale des Eaux chairman Jean-Marie Messier said on Thursday he expected an increase in the company's 1997 operating income of at least 10 percent from 3.8 billion francs in 1996.
He told a news conference that on a constant structure basis, the increase would be 20 percent.
He said that the environment sector, which includes water and waste mananagement, would have an increase in operating income of seven to eight percent.
In the water sector, Messier said that a restructuring program would improve operating profits by 25 percent before 1999.
In construction, Messier said that there would be a break-even result in 1997 against a loss of 1.4 billion in 1996.

In communication, results would be down by 200 million francs due to the start up costs of fixed telecommunications activities in France. The SFR mobile telecoms unit, however, will reach break-even in early 1997.
Messier said the group's cash flow would nearly double to more than 20 billion francs from 11.5 billion in 1996.
